extension.summary: Mixes and endless radio from any song of your library, chosen by sound and kept true to what the song is about.
extension.description: Incipit makes a mix from the song you start it with: the sound engine finds the songs that sound alike, from near to far as the variety lets it reach, and two checks keep the mix true to its first song, Character (the music's profile) and Intent (an AI's judgement of what the song is about, from a listening perspective). Mixes can be saved, edited ("More like this", "Less like this", remove) and repaired when files move; Radio plays an endless station from a song found by scanning through snippets. Formerly MusicIP, whose server made the mixes until 2026.
